title: Rider Cancellation Fees and Waiver Bases, Wayfare Rides
content:
**Standard.** On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** a cancellation fee is charged only on a trip the rider cancelled, as the trip's system record shows (status rider cancelled). Driver cancellations never charge the rider.

## A. When a fee would apply

- A rider cancellation before any driver accepted an on-demand request never carries a fee, and no waiver entry is written.
- **On-demand trip:** a fee would apply when the rider cancels later than the ride option's cancellation grace minutes after the driver accepted.
- **Reserved trip:** a fee would apply when the rider cancels less than the ride option's free-cancellation minutes before the reserved pickup time.
- A cancellation inside the grace period is recorded by the system with a waiver entry of basis *within cancellation grace*, and a reserved cancellation before the cutoff with a waiver entry of basis *reserved window*, so that every rider cancellation after acceptance or inside the reserved cutoff leaves exactly one fee entry or one waiver entry.

## B. Waiver bases, in fixed order

When a fee would apply, it is nevertheless not charged, and one waiver entry for the cancellation fee is written instead, with the **first** basis that holds in this order:

| Order | Basis | Holds when |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | driver ETA exceeded | on-demand: the driver had not arrived and the cancellation came more than the ride option's pickup-delay waiver minutes after the moment of acceptance plus the original pickup estimate in minutes |
| 2 | reserved driver late | reserved: the driver had not arrived the ride option's driver-late minutes after the reserved pickup time |
| 3 | Pass rebook grace | the rider requested a new trip of any ride option within the Wayfare Pass rebook grace minutes of the cancellation |
| 4 | Pass free cancellation | the rider's Wayfare Pass free-cancellation allowance for the calendar month (the Pass plan's free cancellations per month) is not yet used up |

The free-cancellation allowance is counted as the waiver entries of basis Pass free cancellation on the same membership whose date falls in the calendar month, in market local time, that contains the cancellation, first day to last day inclusive.

The Pass bases apply only while the rider's Wayfare Pass membership is in trial, active or pending cancellation status, as the membership record shows; a paused or past-due membership gives no allowance, and Pass rebook grace does not use up the monthly allowance.

## C. The fee when no basis holds

When no basis holds, the fee is the ride option's cancellation fee for an on-demand trip, or its reserved late cancellation fee for a reserved trip.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical times; grace 2 minutes, waiver threshold 5 minutes)

- Accepted 9:00:00, cancelled 9:02:00: not later than 2 minutes after acceptance — no fee would apply; the system writes a *within cancellation grace* waiver entry.
- Accepted 9:00:00, cancelled 9:02:01, driver not arrived, original estimate 6 minutes: a fee would apply; the cancellation is not more than 5 minutes after 9:06:00, so driver ETA exceeded does not hold; the later bases are tested in order.
- Same trip cancelled 9:11:01 with the driver not yet arrived: more than 5 minutes after 9:06:00 — waiver basis driver ETA exceeded, whatever the Pass position.
- Reserved pickup 18:00 with a free-cancellation figure of 60 minutes: a cancellation at 17:00 is not less than 60 minutes before, so no fee would apply (*reserved window* waiver entry); at 17:00:01 a fee would apply unless a basis holds.

## Points of judgement

- A paused membership with an unused monthly allowance gives no Pass free cancellation and no Pass rebook grace.
- When both Pass rebook grace and Pass free cancellation would hold, the waiver is written as Pass rebook grace (it comes first), and the monthly allowance stays unused.
